name: kms:Decrypt -> a distinct can-decrypt edge (IAM-202)
note: kms:Decrypt is a decryption capability, not a data read: IAM-202 gives it its OWN graph edge type `can-decrypt` (was `can-read`), so it is visually and semantically distinct from a DATA-EXFIL `can-read` edge. The edge points at the fixed `datastore:kms-decrypt` node, keeps the human label 'can decrypt ciphertext', and is confirmed-by-policy (the grant is literally present, unconditional). The key is scoped to a concrete ARN so the generic WILDCARD-RESOURCE rule does not also fire - the statement yields exactly this one capability edge.
